concerns: Malay also commonly uses setuju, so the contrast is not exclusive.
response.cue_rationale: Both answers express having the same opinion or accepting a proposal.

preference_risk.rationale: Setuju is ordinary in Indonesian and also plausibly ordinary in Malaysian Malay, although bersetuju provides a useful Malaysian standard/formal contrast.

response.rationale: Setuju is the ordinary Indonesian form, while bersetuju is a standard Malaysian Malay form for having the same opinion or accepting a proposal. The pair is a useful form contrast, though setuju also occurs in Malay.
response.risk_rationale: Learners may overgeneralize bersetuju as the only Malaysian form because setuju is also ordinary there.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Setuju is also understood and used in Malaysian Malay, especially in less formal contexts, but bersetuju remains a credible standard/formal Malaysian preference while setuju is the dominant Indonesian form.
